In modem, there is a possible information disclosure due to missing filtering of sensitive data in crash dumps. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed.

In the modem OTA stack, there is a possible stack-based buffer overflow due to improper validation of scheduling information in SIB1 messages. This could lead to remote code execution or denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed.

In the kernel apsys DVFS driver, there is a possible out-of-bounds read or hardware register corruption due to improper input validation of the frequency index. This could lead to system instability or denial of service with local privileges.
